CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.business_upstream_visible(t uuid, c uuid, p uuid, typ text, sid uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE visible boolean;
BEGIN
 IF NOT typ=ANY(ARRAY['actual_configurations','build_authorization_decisions','build_execution_assessments','build_lots','builds','engineering_configurations','measurement_import_captures','process_revisions','professional_authority_facts','projects','sample_allocations','sample_units','test_resource_facts','test_result_projections','verification_actual_method_batches','verification_formal_requests','verification_preparations','verification_run_identities','verification_run_versions']) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 EXECUTE format('SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.%I
  WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND category_id=$2 AND product_id=$3 AND id=$4)',typ)
 INTO visible USING t,c,p,sid;
 RETURN visible;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.definition_sources_visible(t uuid, c uuid, p uuid, d uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT direct_source_set_visible(t,c,p,COALESCE(
   (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('artifact_id',artifact_id))
    FROM definition_sources WHERE tenant_id=t AND category_id=c AND product_id=p
      AND definition_id=d), '[]'::jsonb))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.direct_source_set_visible(t uuid, c uuid, p uuid, refs jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT category_access(t,c,false) AND jsonb_typeof(refs)='array' AND NOT EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(refs) r
   LEFT JOIN artifact_versions a ON a.id=(r->>'artifact_id')::uuid
     AND a.tenant_id=t AND a.category_id=c AND a.product_id=p
   LEFT JOIN products m ON m.id=a.product_id AND m.tenant_id=t AND m.category_id=c
   LEFT JOIN uploaded_originals o ON o.id=a.original_id AND o.tenant_id=t AND o.category_id=c
   WHERE a.id IS NULL OR m.id IS NULL
     OR NOT source_object_audience(t,c,'products',m.id,m.owner_id,m.visibility)
     OR NOT source_object_audience(t,c,'artifact_versions',a.id,a.owner_id,a.visibility)
     OR (a.original_id IS NOT NULL AND (o.id IS NULL
       OR NOT source_object_audience(t,c,'uploaded_originals',o.id,o.owner_id,o.visibility)))
 )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.upstream_row_visible(t uuid, c uuid, p uuid, typ text, sid uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE visible boolean;
BEGIN
 IF NOT typ=ANY(ARRAY['uploaded_originals','artifact_versions','definition_revisions',
  'product_variants','projects','plan_proposals','bom_revisions','engineering_configurations'])
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 EXECUTE format('SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.%I
  WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND category_id=$2 AND product_id=$3 AND id=$4)',typ)
 INTO visible USING t,c,p,sid;
 RETURN visible;
END $function$
